notes.title: News Update
notes.content:
🎴 WELCOME TO WONDERLAND: THE RED QUEEN PROTOCOL 🎴
A Game of Strategy, Purpose, and Giving

Dear Adventurers,

As the season of gratitude unfolds, we are reminded of the profound impact of community and generosity. Wonderland is a place where every move matters, not just on the chessboard but in the world beyond. Today, we’re proud to announce that Wonderland: The Red Queen Protocol will dedicate all proceeds beyond costs to support causes that resonate deeply with our team. Together, we’re transforming every card played into a beacon of hope.

🌟 The Charities We Support
In the spirit of giving, each charity we’ve selected reflects a commitment to empowering lives and honoring legacies. These incredible organizations represent compassion, resilience, and a brighter future:

🐾 Nickel City Canine Rescue
For the four-legged adventurers who bring joy and companionship, this Buffalo-based rescue works tirelessly to save at-risk dogs and find them loving homes. Your moves in Wonderland will help tails wag and paws prance.
Visit: nickelcitycaninerescue.org

💜 Aid to Victims of Domestic Abuse (AVDA)
Chosen by a survivor among us, AVDA provides critical legal advocacy, counseling, and support for those escaping the cycle of abuse. Their mission is a lifeline for countless individuals and families seeking safety and healing.
Visit: avda.org

🐱 Tuxie’s Legacy - Cat Rescue and Sanctuary
For the feline friends of Wonderland, this sanctuary offers love, care, and forever homes to cats in need. It’s a legacy of kindness that ensures every whisker finds a happy ending.
Visit: facebook.com/share/15DperudvX

🇺🇸 Danny Dietz Memorial Foundation
Honoring the legacy of Navy SEAL Danny Dietz, this foundation supports military families, special operators, and first responders who have given so much. Their annual BBQ Cook-Off is as legendary as the hero it honors.
Visit: dannydietzmemorial.com

♟ Wonderland with a Purpose
Wonderland isn’t just a game—it’s a revolution of play and purpose. Every card played, every strategy devised, contributes to these causes, creating ripples of change that extend far beyond the table.

🕰️ How You Can Join
As we launch the Friends and Family Alpha, your involvement matters more than ever. Dive into Wonderland, shape the game’s future, and stand with us as we support these incredible charities.

🌹 Why It Matters
The Red Queen once said, “It takes all the running you can do to stay in the same place.” But in Wonderland, every step forward takes us closer to building a legacy of generosity, kindness, and hope. By playing the game, you’re also helping create a better world.

💎 Take Your Place at the Table
Wonderland is calling. Will you answer? Your move, adventurer. Together, let’s play with purpose and redefine what it means to win.
